title: Prompt coach
line: Turn a rough request into a draft you can edit.

beats.caption: You give Prompt coach a rough request.
The checked rewrite lands in the input box.
beats.label: pi-prompt-coach

beats.caption: You decide whether to edit it or send it.

takeaway.title: Read it before you send it
takeaway.line: Use the draft to make the task clearer.

notes: The local rewrite and intent-judgment responses are scripted. The real extension checks the intent score and places the draft.

title.text: A rough prompt often names the problem and leaves out what a useful check would look like.

scene.text: Here a scripted rewrite adds a command to reproduce the bug. Prompt coach checks whether the intent survived and puts the rewritten request in your editor.

takeaway.text: Read the draft before sending it. You can keep the details that help and change anything that strays from the task.
